Salaries are permitted and unrelated to riba.

items.stem: Which two statements about Sukuk are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: They represent ownership of or entitlement to underlying assets or projects
Returns should derive from asset performance, not interest
options.rationale: Correct: Sukuk returns stem from assets, not riba.

options.text: They are simply conventional interest-bearing bonds
options.rationale: Sukuk are structured to avoid interest.

options.text: They guarantee a fixed interest coupon
options.rationale: A fixed interest coupon would be non-compliant.
